metadata.name: pixel-grid-loader
metadata.description: A pixel-grid loading indicator for long-running work: an animated 3x3 grid with a shimmering label and a live elapsed timer, in four variants (Drive, Dots, Orbit, Surfer).
features: Four animated variants: Drive (chevron wavefront, square cells), Dots (chevron wavefront, round cells), Orbit (comet lapping the grid), Surfer (Drive loader plus a looping video card)
Shimmering gradient label text, defaults to 'Churning' (or 'Subway surfing' for Surfer) when no label is set
Live elapsed timer in monospace tabular figures, updates every 100ms
Respects prefers-reduced-motion by freezing the grid animation while the timer keeps ticking
Surfer variant falls back to a mini loader with 'Video unavailable' text if the video fails to load

properties.name: label
properties.description: Text shown next to the animated grid. Empty string falls back to the variant's default label.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Which loader animation to render: Drive, Dots, Orbit, or Surfer.

properties.name: videoSrc
properties.description: URL of the looping video shown under the label, only used when variant is Surfer.

properties.name: showDots
properties.description: Show or hide the animated grid, keeping the label and elapsed timer visible.

properties.name: dotColor
properties.description: Primary color: grid dots and the darkest point of the label shimmer.

properties.name: mutedColor
properties.description: Secondary color: elapsed timer text and the lightest points of the label shimmer.

properties.name: autoStart
properties.description: Start the elapsed timer automatically on mount. Turn off to control it via the Start/Stop/Reset actions instead.

actions.label: Start timer
actions.description: Resumes counting from the current elapsed value. No-op if already running.

actions.label: Stop timer
actions.description: Pauses the elapsed timer without resetting its value.

actions.label: Reset timer
actions.description: Sets the elapsed value back to 0s without changing whether it's running.

specifications: Root element has no fixed width/height; it sizes to its content (fit-content).
The Surfer variant renders a 224px-wide video card below the status row; other variants render only the status row.
With autoStart on (default), the elapsed timer starts on mount. With autoStart off, it stays at 0s until the Start action is called from a workflow.
The grid animation pauses while the component is being edited in the WeWeb editor; the elapsed timer also pauses during editing.
dotColor and mutedColor are the only two theme colors: they drive the grid dots, the label shimmer gradient, and the elapsed/fallback text.
